ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface area; low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels form the perimeter and localized mottling (approx 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous field across both lobes; solid black/dark-grey perimeter banding along the trailing edge; concentrated dark mottling and focal spots in the lower-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees relative to the lobe horizontal axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 6 pixels; higher frequency of peaks observed on the lateral regions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed along the trailing boundary of both visible lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular clusters (3-5 pixel diameter) localized near the trailing edge of the left lobe and adjacent to the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, high-contrast vertical linear disruption (dark scar) approximately 45 pixels in length extending from the trailing edge towards the fluke center on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear scar on the left lobe; dark irregular pigmentation patches localized around the median notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion by water spray and surface wake at the base of the peduncle; fluke is tilted showing more of the left ventral lobe than the right.
